summary: Possible typosquat of @solana/web3.js with unverified install-time bundle
details: Package name @solana-labs/web3js closely resembles the widely-used @solana/web3.js Solana SDK (scope difference plus removal of the dot in 'web3.js'). The shipped lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js bundles contain co-located references to require('child_process'), curl, ping, fetch(), and POST in the same regions (around lines 11336-11589 in the ESM bundle and 11441-11589 in the CJS bundle), a pattern frequently associated with command-execution and exfiltration shapes, but the bundle was not fully traced and these tokens may also appear inside benign minified vendor code. Given the name-similarity to a top Solana ecosystem package and the unverified suspicious code shape in the main bundle, a human reviewer should validate publisher legitimacy and confirm whether the child_process+curl+POST regions are reachable on require/install before this version is allowed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
